name: Prashant India Ltd.
about: Prashant India Ltd. does not have any significant business. Previously, it was engaged in textile, agro, and wind power generation businesses in India. The company was formerly known as Prashant Proteins Ltd and changed its name to Prashant India Ltd. in 1995. Prashant India Ltd. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Surat, India.
